r01b-dgr203-terrain.observer: Nominal 2 m configuration; terrain alternatives retain their documented ray-origin convention
held: Same published site, domain, visibility criterion and nominal ephemeris geometry
r01b-dgr203-terrain.qualification: Nominal celestial geometry is held fixed, but horizon ray origins follow 2 m above each represented ground. This is not a common-absolute-ray-origin control. Synthetic averaging and Product 104 are not independent terrain truth.

r01b-dgr203-temporal.observer: Nominal 2 m configuration; terrain alternatives retain their documented ray-origin convention
held: Same site, P78 horizon and observer configuration
r01b-dgr203-temporal.qualification: Discrete-cell estimates do not prove between-sample continuity. The sample-span diagnostic changes the duration statistic. These choices are not the same as refining an event solver.

held: Same site, terrain representation, domain and visibility criterion
Same horizon sampling rules; observer geometry follows height
r01b-dgr203-observer.qualification: Physical observer height changes between 1, 2 and 5 m. This is not the R-01C fixed-absolute versus surface-relative convention comparison.

r01b-dgr203-semantics.observer: Nominal 2 m configuration; terrain alternatives retain their documented ray-origin convention
r01b-dgr203-semantics.semantics: Geometric center versus spherical finite-disc criteria
held: Same site, P78 horizon and observer configuration
r01b-dgr203-semantics.qualification: Center, any-disc and full-disc are different observables. Spherical caps omit Earth oblateness, phase and radiance weighting; a difference does not establish model error for an unchanged requirement.

r01b-dgr203-domain.domain: Nov 6 start; compare Nov 28 versus the stated earlier endpoint
r01b-dgr203-domain.observer: Nominal 2 m configuration; terrain alternatives retain their documented ray-origin convention
held: Same site, P78 horizon and observer configuration
Same center criterion and event solver
r01b-dgr203-domain.qualification: Only the reporting endpoint changes; a clipped endpoint is not a physical transition. The historical seven-versus-8.47-day discrepancy remains unresolved.

r01a-dgr203-five-clones.observer: 2 m above each represented ground for horizon rays; nominal celestial geometry fixed
r01a-dgr203-five-clones.semantics: Geometric Sun/Earth centers; 600 s discovery with event refinement
held: Same site, full seasonal search, local height convention and nominal celestial geometry
Unchanged 80/240 m exterior terrain; first five clones in source order
r01a-dgr203-five-clones.changed: Official local terrain realization and its surface-relative ray origin
r01a-dgr203-five-clones.qualification: Five tested clones are not a calibrated probability distribution. The approximately 13.23-day seasonal interval must not be mixed with the 8.47-day clipped replication result. Local perturbations do not cover far-field or all systematic uncertainty. All five retained the historical 6.5-day simultaneous classification; this is a descriptive pilot result.
